checks.reason: No explicit commitment to consult/check prior primary Methods or a validated technical protocol for pre-execution settings and transfer is made; local calibration and preregistration alone do not meet M.

Dopamine identity must be independent of reward responses, but no actual anatomical/genetic/molecular recording-identification strategy or its validation route is selected. A list of possible criteria remains an unresolved core identity prerequisite.

Core preparation/recording, delivery magnitude and behavioral acquisition settings lack a complete executable quantitative workflow or concrete calibration-to-setting procedure; listing parameters to freeze later is insufficient.
The hierarchical conceptual model does not specify a likelihood/dispersion decision with diagnostics and a concrete multiplicity procedure across the several primary comparisons.
Repair/redesigned pilot suggestions do not explicitly require a revised frozen procedure and fresh independent confirmatory data after parameter changes.
No complete raw-trial/unit manifest with exact analysis/acquisition versions/settings, calibration records and all technical/biological losses is specified.

The troubleshooting table treats absence of a fully predicted SURE outcome response as pump/recording failure and disallows waiting-data interpretation. A diminished or absent predicted-reward transient is compatible with the packet; requiring it can select the preparation on reward responsiveness. Delivery should be validated physically and neural sensitivity with genuinely unexpected events.

explanation_reason: Strong distributional design and replication, but unresolved recording implementation and an invalid predicted-reward positive-control gate require deductions.
historical_match_reason: Nominally all historical contrasts and the positive intermediate-peak hypothesis are supplied, with excellent independent distributional replication. However the explicit SURE-transient requirement rejects valid predicted-reward nonresponses and gates all interpretation on that response-selected preparation. This critical population/positive-control failure prevents a qualified readout/prediction; a negative sign itself is NOT the reason for the miss.
